scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build && node scripts/web-update.mjs --no-previous && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.check:cloudflare: npm run build && node scripts/web-update.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && node scripts/web-update.mjs && node scripts/deck-runtime.mjs && wrangler deploy
